By ignoring the distinction between "starring" (lead role) and "appearing in" (supporting/cameo role), the Planner prematurely synthesized an incorrect answer based on incomplete verification of the actor's billing status. This error was compounded by the Planner's failure to adapt its strategy when WebSurfer encountered technical difficulties (timeouts) in later steps, leading to a final conclusion that was not fully supported by the available evidence regarding the specific criteria of the question.
